line: Grey wood the tide sanded smooth. It still smells of salt.
hint: Found at Tidepools and Old Crossroads, and from raid finales.

line: Wood that came out of the fire black and hard, and kept its warmth.
hint: Found at Ember Caves and Old Crossroads, and from the dungeon and raid finales.

line: Bark from the oldest trees of the Hollow, soft as cork.
hint: Found at Verdant Hollow and Old Crossroads, and from raid finales.

line: Pale ash from a tree the storm struck and did not finish.
hint: Found at Storm Ridge and Old Crossroads, and from raid finales.

line: Black oak the bog kept for a hundred years, and gave back.
hint: Found at Sunken Fen, and from the dungeon and raid finales.

line: Green glass the sea rolled until it forgot it was a bottle.
hint: Found at Tidepools, and from raid finales.

line: A pale stone that glows a little when the reef is dark.
A red stone from the caves where the embers sleep.
hint: Found at Ember Caves, and from raid finales.

line: Clear quartz with a crackle in it, from the high ridge.
hint: Found at Storm Ridge, and from raid finales.

line: A dull stone with an oil sheen. Only the fen finds it.
hint: Found at Sunken Fen, and from raid finales.

line: Dark iron from the caves. It takes a hammer well.
hint: Found at Ember Caves, and from the dungeon.

line: Copper from the ridge, bright as a new coin and faintly humming.
hint: Found at Storm Ridge, and from the dungeon.

line: Gold from before the roads were roads. Thin, soft and very old.
hint: Found at Old Crossroads, and from raid finales.

line: Fine thread spun from the reef at night.
hint: Found at Moonlit Reef, and from the Valley Games.

line: Moss, pressed and dried until it feels like velvet.
hint: Found at Verdant Hollow, and from the Valley Games.

line: Red and gold silk from the Festival lanterns.
hint: Found at Festival Grounds, and from the Festival finale and the Valley Games.
